subject: general
question: TDWP is related to RBUN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, FJMH is related to DHKF. To which of the following is SENP related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• TDWP is written as RBUN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49ed74ff6076a4b7a9a079cfd95e6aa8c867188455a5790630e28e2f4d8cc1ec.png] 

And,

 
• FJMH is written as DHKF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec247fe0995d639d16b70da1a5eb5a99b5c9500fb44ee1844c653b7a0edf4123.png] 

Similarly,

 
• SENP is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d7df67de88ceb4918b418449f1e6440bc32664f179513945c8e903acc821868.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**QCLN**".
